note: A component, imported by Desktop V2 (Settings) and v2 Onboarding (Add a machine), answering J25. Built 2026-10-02 (Q404 A) as packages/ui tailnet-reach-card.tsx, a row of the daemon card in desktop Settings, drawn from the desktop's switch (domovoi:tailnet-reach) and the daemon's tailnet.status. The Onboarding import is not built. The script's restart commands and its per-step progress are the two places the build draws something else; tailnet-reach.progress and tailnet-reach.restart say why.

partial.reason: One domovoi:tailnet-reach request runs a whole change, so the window cannot list each action as it runs: the steps are listed in order while it runs and marked done, failed or not run from where the answer says it stopped. With no tailnet, the mono line carries Tailscale's own words (or that no tailscale command was found) rather than a fixed line.

partial.reason: The switch changes the login service's saved settings through updateDaemonService, which restarts it with the update's readiness check and puts the previous service back on a failure, so the card names that rather than a launchctl or systemctl command Domovoi does not run. The daemon inside this app keeps the design's line.

humanRead.note: Read in Chromium against a fixture with no daemon and no Tailscale, light and dark, at 860 and 420 pixels: off, no tailnet, a hand-set DOMOVOI_HOST, turning on and off, HTTPS certificates off, on and listening, renewal failed, and the daemon not answering. The card adds lines the design has no state for: the daemon not answering on the tailnet (tailnet.status refused), the hand-set DOMOVOI_HOST line, Could not turn it on or off with the desktop's words, and 127.0.0.1 only when the daemon does not listen on the tailnet.
